# Session 4: End-to-End Audio Playback

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    LibraryScreen -->|"playQueue(tracks, idx)"| LibraryVM
    HomeScreen -->|"playTrack(track)"| HomeVM
    LibraryVM --> PlayerController
    HomeVM --> PlayerController
    NowPlayingVM --> PlayerController
    EqualizerVM --> PlayerController
    PlayerController -->|"MediaController (IPC)"| MusicPlayerService
    MusicPlayerService -->|"ExoPlayer"| AudioOutput
    MusicPlayerService -->|"MediaSession"| Notification
    PlayerController -->|"audioSessionId from extras"| AudioFX["Equalizer / BassBoost\nVirtualizer / LoudnessEnhancer"]
    AppNavigation -->|observes| PlayerController
    AppNavigation -->|shows| MiniPlayer
```

## What already works (no change needed)
- `MusicPlayerService` — ExoPlayer + `MediaSession.Builder` is complete; `MediaSessionService` auto-handles the foreground notification
- `AndroidManifest.xml` — all permissions and service declaration are correct
- `MiniPlayer` composable — ready to use
- `NowPlayingScreen` UI — buttons and sliders already wired to ViewModel calls

## Files to create

### `service/PlayerController.kt` (NEW — the central piece)
- `@Singleton @Inject constructor(@ApplicationContext ctx)` — no `AppModule` entry needed
- Builds `MediaController` from `SessionToken(ctx, ComponentName(ctx, MusicPlayerService::class.java))`; uses `Futures.addCallback` on the main executor
- Holds `_queue: List<Track>` + registers a `Player.Listener` on the connected controller for `onIsPlayingChanged`, `onMediaItemTransition`, `onPlaybackStateChanged`, `onShuffleModeEnabledChanged`, `onRepeatModeChanged`
- Exposes `state: StateFlow<PlayerState>` (currentTrack, isPlaying, progressMs, durationMs, isShuffled, repeatMode)
- Exposes `audioSessionId: StateFlow<Int>` — read from `mediaController.sessionExtras.getInt("audioSessionId")` once connected
- Owns and creates `Equalizer`, `BassBoost`, `Virtualizer`, `LoudnessEnhancer` when `audioSessionId` becomes non-zero; exposes them as `val equalizer`, `val bassBoost`, etc.
- Position polling: a coroutine that updates `progressMs` every 500 ms when `isPlaying == true`
- Public API: `playQueue(tracks, startIndex)`, `togglePlayPause()`, `seekTo(ms)`, `next()`, `previous()`, `setVolume(level)`, `setShuffleEnabled(Boolean)`, `setRepeatMode(Int)`, `setBandGain(band, mb)`, `setBassBoost(strength)`, `setVirtualizer(strength)`, `setLoudnessGain(mb)`, `setEqEnabled(Boolean)`

## Files to modify

### [`service/MusicPlayerService.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/service/MusicPlayerService.kt)
- Remove the four effect fields and `attachAudioEffects()` — `PlayerController` owns them now
- Remove the `Player.Listener` added for effects
- After building `mediaSession`, publish `audioSessionId`:
  ```kotlin
  mediaSession = MediaSession.Builder(this, exoPlayer)
      .setSessionActivity(sessionActivityIntent)
      .build()
  mediaSession!!.setExtras(bundleOf("audioSessionId" to exoPlayer.audioSessionId))
  ```
- Remove `setVolume()` — volume is set via `mediaController.volume`

### [`ui/screens/nowplaying/NowPlayingViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/nowplaying/NowPlayingViewModel.kt)
- Add `playerController: PlayerController` to `@Inject constructor`
- Replace the hand-rolled `_state` with a `stateIn` map over `playerController.state`
- Forward `seekTo`, `toggleShuffle`, `cycleRepeat`, `setVolumeLevel` to `playerController`
- Keep `toggleFavorite()` calling `repo.setFavorite()`

### [`ui/screens/equalizer/EqualizerViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/equalizer/EqualizerViewModel.kt)
- Add `playerController: PlayerController` to `@Inject constructor`
- In `init`, `collect` `playerController.audioSessionId`; call existing `initFromHardware(playerController.equalizer!!)` once non-zero
- Replace all `// TODO: forward to service` stubs with real calls to `playerController.setBandGain()`, `setBassBoost()`, `setVirtualizer()`, `setLoudnessGain()`, `setEqEnabled()`

### [`ui/screens/library/LibraryViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryViewModel.kt)
- Add `playerController: PlayerController` to `@Inject constructor`
- Add `fun playTrack(tracks: List<Track>, index: Int) = playerController.playQueue(tracks, index)`

### [`ui/screens/library/LibraryScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/library/LibraryScreen.kt)
- Change `items(state.tracks)` → `itemsIndexed(state.tracks)` to capture index
- Replace `onClick = { /* TODO: play */ }` with:
  ```kotlin
  onClick = {
      viewModel.playTrack(state.tracks, index)
      navController.navigate(Screen.NowPlaying.route)
  }
  ```

### [`ui/screens/home/HomeViewModel.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/home/HomeViewModel.kt) + [`HomeScreen.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/screens/home/HomeScreen.kt)
- Same pattern: add `playerController` to VM, add `playTrack()`, wire the recently played `onClick`

### [`ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/ui/navigation/AppNavigation.kt)
- Accept a `playerController: PlayerController` parameter (passed from `MainActivity`)
- Wrap the `NavHost` in a `Scaffold` whose `bottomBar` observes `playerController.state`:
  - Show `MiniPlayer` when `state.currentTrack != null`
  - Wire `MiniPlayer.onPlayPauseClick` → `playerController.togglePlayPause()`
  - Wire `MiniPlayer.onSkipNextClick` → `playerController.next()`
  - Wire `MiniPlayer.onBarClick` → `navController.navigate(Screen.NowPlaying.route)`
  - Apply `contentPadding` to `NavHost` so screens are not obscured

### [`MainActivity.kt`](app/src/main/java/com/musicplayer/MainActivity.kt)
- Inject `PlayerController` via `@Inject lateinit var playerController: PlayerController`
- Pass it to `AppNavigation(navController, playerController)`
- Call `startForegroundService(Intent(this, MusicPlayerService::class.java))` in `onCreate` so the service is alive before the user taps play (optional but recommended for fast first-connect)

## Notification (no extra work needed)
`MediaSessionService` + `MediaSession` with a running `ExoPlayer` automatically:
- Creates the notification channel `notification_channel_playback` (the `strings.xml` key already exists)
- Shows album art from `MediaItem.mediaMetadata.artworkUri`
- Provides transport controls on the lock screen

The only requirement: each `Track` → `MediaItem` conversion in `PlayerController.playQueue()` must set `MediaMetadata` with title, artist, album, and `artworkUri = "content://media/external/audio/albumart/${track.albumId}"`.

## Key data flow when user taps a track

```
TrackListItem.onClick
  → LibraryViewModel.playTrack(tracks, index)
    → PlayerController.playQueue(tracks, index)
      → mediaController.setMediaItems(mediaItems, index)
      → mediaController.prepare()
      → mediaController.play()
        → MusicPlayerService (ExoPlayer) starts audio
        → Media3 shows notification with album art
      → Player.Listener.onIsPlayingChanged → playerController.state updated
        → NowPlayingViewModel.uiState updated
        → MiniPlayer visible
  → navController.navigate(Screen.NowPlaying.route)
```

### 1. Heart icon doesn't turn blue immediately

That `Track` object is a snapshot frozen in memory when `playQueue()` was called. When `toggleFavorite()` calls `repo.setFavorite()`, Room updates on disk, but the `Track` copy sitting in `PlayerController._queue` is never refreshed — so `playerController.state` never changes, so the UI never re-renders.

**Fix (two changes):**
- In `NowPlayingViewModel`, add a `MutableStateFlow<Boolean?>` called `_favoriteOverride`, initially `null`. Use `combine(playerController.state, _favoriteOverride)` to build `uiState`, preferring the override when it's non-null.
- In `toggleFavorite()`, set `_favoriteOverride.value = !current` optimistically before awaiting Room.
- Reset `_favoriteOverride` to `null` via `distinctUntilChanged()` on the track ID whenever the track changes.

---

### 2. Recently Played list not updating

**Root cause:** `TrackDao.getRecentlyPlayed()` orders by `lastPlayed DESC`. Every track starts with `lastPlayed = 0`. The DAO has `incrementPlayCount(id)` which sets `lastPlayed = System.currentTimeMillis()`, but nobody ever calls it. `PlayerController.playQueue()` and `onMediaItemTransition` just update the in-memory state — they never touch Room.

**Fix:** Inject `MusicRepository` into `PlayerController` and call `repo.incrementPlayCount(trackId)` inside `onMediaItemTransition` when `mediaItem` is non-null. This is the right place because it fires for every track transition regardless of which screen is visible.

---
